q.delivery: How much does delivery cost, and how long does it take?
q.guestOrders: Can I order without an account?
q.soldOut: What if an item or color is sold out?
q.customOrders: Can I request a custom order?

a.delivery: Delivery is a flat 170 ден across Tetovo. Once your order is marked as shipped, delivery can take up to 3 business days.
a.payment: Pay at delivery is available now — we'll call to confirm your order before preparing it. Card payment is coming soon.
a.points: You earn 5% of your order subtotal (excluding delivery) as points whenever you're signed in at checkout. Once you have at least 300 points, you can redeem them for 0.6 ден off per point.
a.guestOrders: Yes — guest checkout is always available. Guest orders don't earn points and can't be tracked afterward; sign in if you'd like to track your order.
a.soldOut: Sold-out products or colors are clearly marked and can't be added to your cart. Check back later — we restock regularly.
a.customOrders: For custom requests, reach out to us directly using the contact details below and we'll do our best to help.
